title: 4 new things in your app!
intro: Build 2 from Mom's review: Today is one card with one button, your checkpoints get a tick, your solo has four readiness bars, and your Backstage Pass lives in the app now. Tap 👀 Show me how for the steps, or ▶ Try it to jump straight in.

items.pitch: The top of Today says what today is and has one big button for it.
steps: Open Today: the first card shows the day and how many minutes the plan is.
Tap the big button: “▶ Start”, “▶ 15-min memory run” or “▶ Watch + picture”, whatever today is.
Your tricks, games and Memorize card moved down to “✨ Pick one extra”: the solo first, then those.
The doors, the dare and the rest wait under “✨ More for today”.

items.pitch: Every finish line on the way to the show can be ticked. Made it? Tap ✓.
steps: On the week card, the next checkpoints have a “✓ Made it” button.
Made it? Tap it. A green ✅ stays for two days, and Mom's phone sees it too.
Tap “📍 All checkpoints” to see every one, all the way to the Ball.

items.pitch: Four honest bars: Know, Clean, Tricks, Perform. Nothing to fill in, they read your own practice.
steps: Today says “moves known”: that's your Pause & Predict score, out of 28.
Tap “How ready?” for the four bars and what each one means.
On your solo card, open “🌸 How ready is the solo?” any time.
Know grows when you get a move right twice in a row in Pause & Predict.

items.pitch: Your Pass is in the app: ten short parts, one quick check each, a star for every one you get right.
steps: On Today, find “My Backstage Pass” and tap “Read it ▶”.
Read the part, then answer the one question. Right = a star and the next part.
Every day there's a “Tip of the day” from your Pass. Your bunny says it too.
